title: Skin First
caption:
Skin First

My work is makeup —
sharing why it matters, and the joy it brings.
But the longer I do this work,
the more I believe what matters most
is the skin underneath, and the person wearing it.

When I was younger,
I thought makeup could make up for skipped skincare.
With age, I feel it more each day:
the base underneath is what counts.

Humidity, UV, heat —
every city is hard on skin in its own way.
As a makeup artist,
I want to suggest skincare that suits the city you live in.

Your skincare before makeup
may have room to become even better.
